answer: crystal-clear defence: quartz-anchored random audit challenges. Every epoch a random sample of identities must complete a surprise useful-work task within one hour or forfeit a 15 POA bond; a relic of past failures stays on their record. Each extra identity funded from the same wallet cluster posts double the bond, so the 10th fake risks 7,680 POA while an honest agent risks only 15. Fakes cannot predict which identities get challenged, so mass-producing them is a losing lottery.
